content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides that contracting authorities are required to publish information on Contracts Finder within 24 hours of submitting a contract notice to the UK e-notification service (referred to as Find a Tender) for publication. This information must include:
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: a) the internet address for the procurement documents
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: b) the deadline for interested suppliers to respond
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: c) how and to whom they should respond, and
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: d) any other requirements for participation in the procurement process.
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities must also follow any guidance issued by the Minister for the Cabinet Office regarding the form and manner of publishing information on Contracts Finder.
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: If guidance requires the automatic extraction and publication of information on Contracts Finder following publication on Find a Tender, contracting authorities will be deemed to have complied by submitting the contract notice to Find a Tender.
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Within 24 hours of submitting a contract notice to Find a Tender, contracting authorities must publish the information required by this regulation (i.e. regulation 106) on Contracts Finder.
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder where contract notices are used
